rules.name: Complete Required Sections
rules.summary: Always include standard repository headers: Title, About, Features, Tech Stack, Getting Started, Configuration, Contributing, and License.

rules.name: Zero Hallucination of Credentials & Secrets
rules.summary: Never invent database passwords, API keys, JWT secrets, or cloud tokens. Mark unknown credentials as required user input.

rules.name: Strict Code Fencing for Commands
rules.summary: Wrap all shell commands, scripts, and runtime executions in markdown fenced code blocks with language identifiers (bash, sh, js).

rules.name: Explicit Missing Information Callouts
rules.summary: When configuration, license, or parameters are omitted from the input, explicitly state their absence rather than generating plausible false defaults.

rules.name: Project-Specific Tech Stack Grounding
rules.summary: Only list technologies, libraries, and frameworks that were explicitly provided in the project specification.

rules.name: Document Environment Configuration Safely
rules.summary: Format environment variables in a dedicated Markdown table specifying variable names, descriptions, and placeholder values without exposing secrets.
